panels.general_description: Color photograph of an infant lying on its back on white linens with a green and yellow cloth behind, with tubing and a tape-surrounded mouth region, labelled "1A".
panels.detailed_description: The label "1A" is printed above and to the left of the photograph. The infant lies with the head toward the left and the face turned toward the camera, the mouth open, with orange-tan tape or padding around the nose and mouth and a tube leaving the chin area. Blue and clear tubing and cables cross the image; a grey probe or device sits on a hand near the top center, and a hand at the bottom carries a taped line with a purple connector. A large white wrapped or folded cloth lies across the abdomen and lower trunk; the chest is bare. The limbs are flexed and the feet are visible at the right edge; foot, toe, ear, eye and nipple findings cannot be assessed reliably at this resolution. No printed text other than the panel label is visible.

clinical_significance.statement: The source presents this photograph as the neonate in the NICU showing dysmorphic features.

evidence.quote: A) The neonate in the NICU. Dysmorphism in the form of microophthalmia, hypertelorism, wide spaced nipples, pectus excavatum, club foot and big toe is seen in this photo.

On examination, the baby had microphthalmia, hypertelorism, corneal clouding, micrognathia, bilateral anotia, central cleft lip (harelip) and cleft palate, arthrogryposis (fixed flexion deformity), bilateral congenital talipes equinovarus (CTEV), wide-spaced nipple, pectus excavatum, scoliosis, genu recurvatum, and bilateral large extended big toe (Figure 1A).

limitations: The photo is small and low resolution; the individual anomalies named in the caption cannot be confirmed from the pixels.
Whether the wrapped item over the abdomen and lower trunk is a dressing, cloth or cast is not determined.
